_readme: Single source of truth for the bird photo pages. Easiest way to add photos: python3 scripts/add_photos.py PHOTO... --location "..." [--home]  (see that script for details). After editing this file by hand, run:  python3 scripts/build_site.py
photos: one entry per image under assets/img/gallery/<species-slug>/. 'crop' (optional) is the vertical
object-position used when a portrait photo is cropped into a 4:3 tile, e.g. "12%" keeps the top in view.
home: ordered list of photos on index.html. Use {"file": ..., "fill": true} to crop a portrait to 4:3
in the top block; other portraits are shown full-size in the portrait block at the bottom.
species: maps each species folder to its display name and group. groups: order, titles and blurbs of
the bird-group pages (optional 'cover' = photo used on the gallery.html overview card).

groups.title: Raptors & Owls
groups.blurb: Eagles, kites, hawks, falcons, vultures and owls.

groups.title: Herons, Egrets & Waders
groups.blurb: Long-legged birds of marshes, shores and shallow water.

groups.title: Ducks, Geese & Seabirds
groups.blurb: Swimmers and divers: ducks, geese, pelicans, cormorants, gulls and terns.

groups.title: Woodpeckers, Barbets & Kingfishers
groups.blurb: Tree-drummers, colourful barbets and sharp-billed fishers.

groups.title: Crows, Jays & Treepies
groups.blurb: Clever, bold members of the crow family.

groups.title: Doves, Parrots, Cuckoos & Gamebirds
groups.blurb: Pigeons and doves, parakeets, cuckoos, peafowl, quail and turkeys.

groups.title: Finches, Sparrows & Cardinals
groups.blurb: Seed-eaters of gardens, grasslands and hedgerows.

groups.title: Orioles, Blackbirds & Starlings
groups.blurb: Bright orioles, blackbirds, meadowlarks, starlings and mynas.

groups.title: Flycatchers, Thrushes & Songbirds
groups.blurb: Bluebirds, robins, flycatchers, wrens, warblers and other small songbirds.
